items.summary: Recommendation: retain only the existing bounded, reversible workstreams and reject new queue work, production changes, revenue/ROI claims, and launch proposals. Attribution remains incomplete, direct costs are unavailable, several telemetry sources are missing, and active site work already covers the defensible candidates; do not duplicate it. Keep the private-preview gate unchanged. Owner decision: authorize continuation of the existing report-only evidence and measurement work until its stated acceptance thresholds are met?
